rich_narrative.summary: Muslim Hands USA provides humanitarian aid and disaster relief for international emergencies like those in <cite id="4">Gaza, Sudan, and Yemen</cite>. In FY2024, the charity experienced early-stage revenue growth, reaching <cite id="3">$2,027,541 in total revenue</cite>. It maintains high alignment for Muslim donors through <cite id="2">verified zakat-eligible programs</cite> serving asnaf categories like the poor and needy. However, financial performance presents significant areas for concern. The organization reported a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 35.3% in FY2024</cite>, which falls well below the 75% industry benchmark and the peer median of 89.2%. When calculated on a Program Ratio score basis, the ratio sits at 35%, placing direct program spending at a low level relative to total expenditure. On governance, Charity Navigator assigns the organization an <cite id="1">overall score of 71/100</cite>. The charity retains strong liquidity, holding <cite id="1">15.2 months of working capital in reserves</cite>, which provides operational stability but highlights a need to balance cash accumulation with active program delivery.
